KEY FACTS:
- The FY 2026 Budget of the United States Government (President's Budget) presents actual amounts for the year ended September 30, 2024.
- NASA reconciled amounts of the FY 2023 column on the Statement of Budgetary Resources (SBR) to the actual amounts for FY 2023 in the FY 2025 President's Budget.
- Underdelivered Orders at the end of the period totaled $12 billion as of September 30, 2024.
- Underdelivered Orders at the end of the period totaled $13 billion as of September 30, 2023.
- Total Undelivered Orders for 2024 equal $12,214 million.
- Total Undelivered Orders for 2023 equal $12,909 million.
